title: YumeTwins Alternatives: 4 Kawaii Boxes Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a YumeTwins alternative? Compare four kawaii boxes by price and contents, from Sanrio collabs shipped from Tokyo to a plush every month.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which box is closest to YumeTwins?


Kawaii Box. Like YumeTwins, it packs a monthly box of Japan-exclusive kawaii goods in Tokyo, with Sanrio collabs and plushies. It holds 8 to 10 items against 5 to 7 and costs about the same once shipping and US duty are added.


Why did YumeTwins get more expensive in the US?


On September 16, 2026, YumeTwins raised US shipping from $12.50 to $14.50 a box and began charging import duty as a percentage of the box price, which comes to $5.25 on the monthly plan. US subscribers on prepaid plans bought before that date were billed a one-time charge in late September covering the difference on their remaining boxes.


Is YumeTwins the same company as TokyoTreat?


Yes. ICHIGO Inc. runs YumeTwins alongside the TokyoTreat and Sakuraco snack boxes, and all three share one help center. If you want Japanese snacks instead of kawaii goods, TokyoTreat is the sister box to look at.


Can I buy just one box?


YumeTwins and Kawaii Box sell subscriptions only, and both suggest subscribing monthly and canceling after the first box. YumeTwins also sells gift plans that don’t renew, and every Cratejoy box on this list can be sent as a gift from its listing page.


Which of these boxes suits a tween or teen?


Little Rubi’s Plush and More is built for tweens and teens. Its optional checkout question about name, age, and favorite character gives the seller what they need to match the plush to the kid.
